Skips URLs matching the exclude path pattern

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::crawl;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"exclude_paths\":[\"/admin/.*\"],\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = crawl(&engine, &url).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
